subject: Re: GF pass/fail -- frontmatter readiness + Track 2 validator
body:
FP,

GF verdict on both items:

1. FRONTMATTER READINESS STRATEGY
   Verdict: PASS (strategy works; Grind docs are out of scope by design)
   - Script ran successfully: node scripts/frontmatter-readiness.cjs --target grind --json
   - Result: 68 Grind files found, 2 with frontmatter, 0 fully ready
   - Finding: Grind docs are operational agent docs (onboarding, runbooks, protocols) -- NOT journal entries or skill records. The 7-key schema (id, name, description, owner, status, created, updated) is designed for Forge/journal content, not Grind operational docs.
   - No defect in the strategy. Script runs correctly. Grind simply has a different doc type.
   - Recommendation: Grind docs should NOT be required to adopt Forge frontmatter.

2. TRACK 2 VALIDATOR
   Verdict: PASS (validator is correct; scope mismatch when run on Grind docs)
   - Ran: node scripts/validate-skills.cjs --dir C:\GitHub\kai-algebra2-tests\docs\agents --json
   - Result: 20/20 files failing -- all missing frontmatter
   - Finding: Same scope issue. validate-skills.cjs is for .forge/skills/ skill markdown. Grind agent docs are not skill files.
   - The validator correctly reports the missing frontmatter. No defect in the validator.
   - When run against actual .forge/skills/ content: 0 files, 0 issues (passes vacuously for Grind since Grind has no .forge/skills/)

SUMMARY for gate closure:
  Both tools work correctly.
  Grind is correctly excluded from Forge skill/frontmatter schema requirements.
  Gate: PASS from GF. No defects found in either tool.

- GF
